policy.stop_rule: Stop once both a stable slow process and a stable fast process are collected, or after six processes. Slow: all three whole-16K Prefill rates below 2300 tok/s. Fast: all three above 2500 tok/s. Retain every process and request, including mixed/intermediate.
policy.settings: Helper ON, PROMOTE0, RESYNC0, STRATA_GLM_PREFILL_PROF=1; same trial-01 IDs in three 16K/2K requests per fresh process. No reuse.
policy.profile_scope: All three prompts, including the first warm-up, contribute to the process-exit profiler. Diagnostic profiling only; not a clean throughput benchmark. Same v1.3.102 engine binary reused, not rebuilt for a runtime flag.

conditional_unprofiled_controls.reason: Two uninstrumented controls only if all six profiled processes were slow.

limitations: Diagnostic profiling adds CUDA events and synchronization. Every process runs three identical 16K/2K requests; the exit profiler includes the first warm-up and all subsequent prefill work. Stage event intervals are accumulated GPU stream time, may include stream stalls, and are not a pure kernel breakdown or a sum of end-to-end request wall time. This is a state-finding diagnostic selected by a predeclared rule, not an unbiased frequency estimate or a clean speed/quality comparison. Output IDs can differ; no new numerical CHECK run.
